subject: The one thing 90% of users skip
preview_text: A user's confession about a hidden feature that changed everything. You'll want to read this before your next date.
body_paragraphs: Last week, a user named Jake sent our team an email that stopped us cold. He said he was about to delete SoulPlan because he thought it was just another date idea generator. But then he stumbled on something he'd been ignoring for weeks. Now he and his girlfriend haven't had a boring Friday in a month.

Jake admitted he'd been skipping the surprise date planner feature because it felt like extra work. He was wrong. One night, out of frustration, he tapped it and set a budget under 50 bucks. The app did the rest. His partner had no idea what was coming, and the look on her face when they ended up at a secret rooftop mini-golf course? He said it was better than any anniversary gift.

Here's the truth: the surprise date planner isn't just a gimmick. It's built to do the heavy lifting for you. You pick the vibe and budget, and it finds local spots you'd never discover alone. Then it sends your partner a mystery invite. No planning stress, no routine trap. Just the thrill of showing you care.

Open SoulPlan now and try the surprise date planner once. That's all I'm asking. One surprise date, and see if your partner doesn't light up. P.S. Jake's favorite part? The app hides the venue name until the last minute, so there's zero chance of spoiling it.
